code:
# mid-incident, on-call engineer runs:
kubectl scale deployment payments-api --replicas=10

# live cluster now says: replicas: 10
# Git still says:        replicas: 5
caption: No pull request, no commit — the cluster and Git now disagree.

code:
loop forever:
  desired = read manifests from Git
  live    = read actual state from cluster
  if live != desired:
    mark OutOfSync
    alert, or reconcile automatically
  wait briefly / for a webhook
caption: The same observe-diff-act pattern as a Kubernetes controller, one level up.
